title: 3 大道虚衍梦幻还真124 假痴不癫22
slug: 苟在诸天从黑暗佛门开始
lines: 明明是晨间，阳光却透着阴寒。
西风摇曳窗外老树，树影婆娑，像一团幽灵贴印在油纸窗上。
不远处还传来柴火劈里啪啦地炸响。
简单的土灶小屋的烟囱，正在冒着炊烟。
风里隐约传来孟小娘子说话的声音，还有丫丫在院子里“哒哒哒”的轻快脚步声，但...都很模糊。
李玄把目光落在了“1道点”上。
大道虚衍，梦幻还真，每1道点可以进行一次推演，以死亡为截点进行回归，可从该次推演中获得的【境界】、【宝物】中任意选择一样带回。
他决定推演。
道点很珍贵，按着面板，纵然将整个世界全部都探索结束了，一共也只有4次推演机会。
可如今，他连自己是谁都不知道，陷在怎样的危机也不知道。
这1道点甚至可以说是原主以死亡换来的。
‘希望，我能够找到答案。’
李玄深吸一口气。
‘使用。’
面板上，“1道点”消失。
他隐约看到虚空中出现了一条岔道。
原本笔直往前的路径突兀停止，而他则是扑入了那条岔道。
所谓推演，就是暂停了原本的时间线，而进入了另一条“if”的时间线......待到另一条“if”的时间线终结，他将回归到岔道处，进行原本的时间线。
这种感觉须臾而逝。
然后...一切毫无变化。
他依然是李玄。
依然躺在床榻上。
而这时，窗隙里飘来了香气。
粥香。
粥稀如明镜，清可照人影。
带壳的糙米，混杂着不知名的山间野菜，还有十几粒豆子煮的稀烂，混杂其中，从而形成了一种浑浊的糊糊。
可很香。
放了点盐巴，还飘了一星油花。
粥碗有三。
丫丫正眼巴巴地看着李玄手中的粥碗流口水。
因为几乎所有的豆子，糙米，野菜全在李玄碗里，丫丫和娘亲的碗里几乎就是清汤。
“爹爹要补身体。”孟小娘子试图用“听话懂事”把女儿那渴求的眼神给掰回来。
她知道自家郎君并非重男轻女之悲，对女儿还是疼爱的，哪怕失忆了...那种疼爱应该还是刻在骨子里。若是女儿一直用这般眼神盯着郎君，郎君保不准会把碗里的豆米分一大半给女儿。可郎君还要恢复身体，她不能让郎君这样。
content_en:
It was obviously morning, but the sunshine was filled with coldness.
The west wind swayed the old trees outside the window, and the shadows of the trees were whirling, like a ghost stuck on the oil paper window.
Not far away there was the crackling sound of firewood.
The chimney of the simple earth stove hut is emitting smoke.
Meng's voice could be faintly heard in the wind, as well as Yaya's brisk footsteps in the yard, but... they were all blurry.
Li Xuan set his sights on "One Point".
The avenue is virtual and the dream is real. Each point can be deduced once, with death as the cut-off point for return. You can choose any of the [realms] and [treasures] obtained in the deduction and bring them back.
He decided to deduce.
Dao points are very precious. According to the panel, even if the entire world is explored, there are only 4 deduction opportunities in total.
But now, he doesn't even know who he is or what kind of crisis he is in.
This point can even be said to have been obtained by the original owner in exchange for death.
'Hopefully, I can find the answer. ’
Li Xuan took a deep breath.
'use. ’
On the panel, "1 dot" disappears.
He vaguely saw a fork in the void.
The path that originally went straight forward suddenly stopped, and he plunged into the fork.
The so-called deduction means pausing the original timeline and entering another "if" timeline... When the other "if" timeline ends, he will return to the fork in the road and proceed with the original timeline.
This feeling passed away in a moment.
And then...nothing changes.
He is still Li Xuan.
Still lying on the bed.
At this time, the fragrance wafted from the window.
The porridge is fragrant.
————
The porridge is as thin as a mirror, clear enough to reflect people's shadows.
Brown rice in the shell, mixed with unknown wild vegetables from the mountains, and a dozen boiled beans were mixed in, forming a turbid paste.
But very fragrant.
Added some salt and a splash of oil.
There are three porridge bowls.
Yaya was drooling as she stared at the porridge bowl in Li Xuan's hand.
Because almost all the beans, brown rice, and wild vegetables were in Li Xuan's bowl, and the bowls of Yaya and Mother were almost clear soup.
"Daddy needs to replenish his health." Mrs. Meng tried to get her daughter's longing eyes back by being "obedient and sensible."
She knew that her husband was not a patriarchal man, but still loved her daughter. Even if he lost his memory... that love should still be engraved in his bones. If his daughter kept staring at Lang Jun like this, he would probably give half of the beans in the bowl to his daughter. But Lang Jun still needs to recover, and she can't let him do this.
title_en: 3 The avenue is false and the dream is real 124 Fake ignorance is not crazy 22
